items.title: Gay out for duck as Pakistan impress against County Select XI
items.description: England opening batter Emilio Gay was out for a duck as Pakistan made a strong start to their tour against a Professional County Club Select XI.

items.title: Rangers booed off after Europa League exit as McInnes' winless start goes on
items.description: Derek McInnes' winless start to life at Rangers hit its lowest point as they were embarrassed and dumped out of the Europa League to a chorus of boos by Jagiellonia Bialystok on aggregate following a 1-1 draw at Ibrox.

items.title: 'Dad rang and I was like: What's happening?' - England U20s boss on Uefa threat
items.description: England head coach Lydia Bedford says she has been told to "just continue as usual" before next month's Under-20 Women's World Cup, despite the threat of a Uefa boycott over an ongoing row with Fifa.

items.title: NRL legend Cherry-Evans signs one-year deal with Hull FC
items.description: NRL legend Daly Cherry-Evans has signed a one-year deal for Hull FC which sees him complete a shock switch to Super League for the 2027 season.

items.title: PSG agree deal in principle for Barcelona's Torres
items.description: Paris St-Germain agree a deal in principle to sign Barcelona forward Ferran Torres from Barcelona for about £43m.

items.title: Explained: Why Leicester City has been put up for sale for £224m
items.description: Sky Sports' Rob Dorsett explains why Thai owners King Power are seeking to sell Leicester City for more than £200m.

items.title: Rory finds water on nightmare double-bogey 18th hole!
items.description: Rory McIlroy had an eighteenth hole to forget at the FedEx St. Jude Championship.

items.title: McIlroy makes woeful start to FedExCup Playoffs as Spieth shares early lead
items.description: Rory McIlroy made a woeful start to the FedExCup Playoffs as he shot four-over par opening round at the FedEx St. Jude Championship in Memphis.

items.title: PSV winger Driouech at Ibrox before expected Rangers move
items.description: PSV Eindhoven winger Couhaib Driouech is at Ibrox to watch Rangers face Jagiellonia Bialystok pending a transfer to the Scottish Premiership club.
